title: Employment Contract Analysis
summary: This Employment Contract The monthly salary is RM6,000, as stated in the compensation clause. Employment begins on 1 January 2027, which is the agreed start date. The employee serves a six-month probation period from the start date, during which either party may terminate with fourteen days written notice.
plainLanguageExplanation:
After written confirmation, either party may terminate with sixty days written notice.

The employee must protect confidential information as part of the confidentiality clause.

Employee: Avery Example
Employer: Example Research
Start date: 2027-01-01
Monthly salary: RM6,000 PROBATION
The employee serves a six-month probation period from the start date.
During probation, either party may terminate with fourteen days written notice. PROBATION
The employee serves a six-month probation period from the start date.
During probation, either party may terminate with fourteen days written notice. CONFIRMATION
After written confirmation, either party may terminate with sixty days written notice.
Confidentiality: The employee must protect confidential information. Review the probation and confirmation terms together before applying either notice provision.

statements.text: This document is an employment contract between Avery Example (the employee) and Example Research (the employer), establishing a monthly salary of RM6,000 starting January 1, 2027. The employee serves a six-month probation period from the start date, during which either party may terminate with fourteen days written notice. After probation, written confirmation is required before either party may terminate with sixty days written notice. The employee must also maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.
